name: Flex Ltd.
summary: Flex Ltd. provides technology innovation, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions to data center, communications, enterprise, consumer, automotive, healthcare, industrial, and power industries in the Americas, Asia, and Europe. The company operates through three segments: Integrated Technology Solutions (ITS), Regulated Manufacturing Solutions (RMS), and Cloud and Power Infrastructure (CPI). The ITS segment offers flexible supply and manufacturing solutions for communications, including high speed networking, enterprise, and satellite communications systems, as well as lifestyle solutions comprising products across commercial, home, and personal product categories.
